name: Hardware quantum random numbers
summary: Encryption keys need numbers that nobody can guess or reproduce. Ordinary computers use formulas that look random, whereas quantum random number generators measure unpredictable quantum events such as single photons hitting a beam splitter or vacuum noise. Compact circuit cards now plug into servers and telecom equipment to supply physical randomness directly. Manufacturers report peak bitrates under different setups rather than one shared multi-year price table, so this card tracks hardware availability milestones instead of a curve.
capability: Generate verifiable physical randomness from quantum photon fluctuations.
trendSummary: Commercial quantum entropy cards ship in compact chips and server modules for key seeding.
